useWhen: An operator hands over invoices (an export from Xero, QuickBooks Online, freee請求書, MoneyForward クラウド請求書, Zoho Invoice or FreshBooks, or lines they typed) and asks for per-rate consumption tax, a check of a Japanese qualified invoice's required contents, receivable or payable journal entries, or a conversion to another invoice format
avoidWhen: Sending invoices, verifying a registration number with the NTA, certifying an invoice as qualified, filing consumption tax, or reading from a live invoicing or accounting service; handling real invoices on a remote inference rail without the operator's consent

inputs.lines: invoice lines the operator gave, with tax rates
inputs.context: currency, tax-inclusive or exclusive amounts, the rounding direction and which invoices to post

outputs.totals: per-rate consideration and consumption tax, rounded once per invoice per rate
outputs.checks: missing qualified-invoice contents, stated-tax differences and the transitional deduction percent
outputs.ledger: the ledger with posted receivable or payable entries, and the skipped invoices with reasons
outputs.conversion: the invoices in another format, with notes on fields that format cannot hold

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be enabled in the profile by its owner

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers matches the entry id.
